description: Verify Podman can pull a pinned multi-platform image from the NJU GHCR mirror by tag, index digest, and platform manifest digest.
preconditions: The minimal feature configuration is deployed and the installation case has passed.
assertions: Podman pulls the image by tag, root index digest, and linux/amd64 platform manifest digest through the client Service.

checks.description: Pull the upstream image by tag.
Pull the upstream image by root index digest.
Pull the linux/amd64 platform manifest by digest.

outputs: Case result includes all three references and pull modes.
